description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: wooden pier dock segment, row of wooden mooring piles, small harbor storage shed, wine barrels stack, fish hook rack, small harbor beacon lamp post, small rowboat, rusty anchor, wooden lookout hut on legs, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
